description.en: Metasequoia-inspired preserved leafy branch organ only, with explicit opposite lateral attachments and paired/decussate small flat leaves separated by readable node intervals. Specimen display, no full tree/crown, roots or unsupported associated reproductive organs. Thickness, compression, leaf counts and nominal span are artistic, not measured fossil data.
description.zh: Metasequoia启发保存叶枝器官，明确对生侧枝、小扁叶成对并交互排列，节点间隔清楚。仅标本展示，不造完整树冠、根或未关联生殖器官；厚度、压缩程度、叶数和名义展宽属艺术选择，非化石测量。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.
artistic_choices.zh: 名义尺度、原创配色、重复结构数量及静态姿态属美术选择。不作严格种级复原、标本复制、运动机制、动画或共存复原承诺。

structural_scope.en: Preserved fossil branch organ only, opposite laterals and paired/decussate leaf topology with readable intervals. Unassociated cones, roots and whole tree are omitted; thickness/compression/counts are teaching choices.
structural_scope.zh: 仅保存化石枝器官，对生侧枝与成对/交互叶拓扑间隔可读。省略未关联球果、根和整树，厚度压缩及数量属教学选择。
